prompt:
Create award-quality square 1024x1024 key art for an experimental touch game.
Make one authored visual statement, never a mobile UI, app icon, generic fantasy
poster, mascot illustration, or children's cartoon. Keep the decisive mechanism
inside the central 60 percent. The bottom 20 percent contains only expendable
atmosphere because store controls may cover it. Reserve the upper 24 percent as
a calm, low-detail field for later typography. Deliver pure textless raster art:
no words, letters, logos, borders, frames, interface panels, badges, or mockups.
 Inside a deep charcoal cubic chamber, one small pristine white circular capsule
 fires a luminous pigment pulse to the right while the capsule is visibly thrown
 backward along a thin recoil trail. Cyan, hot magenta, violet and acid-lime
 splashes strike the four boundaries, with crisp frozen droplets and broad empty
 black space between them. No person and no gun. Radical Swiss editorial
 printmaking, screen-printed ink grain, severe geometry, asymmetric composition,
 high contrast, elegant rather than comic, instantly readable at thumbnail size.

composition.title: RECOIL BLOOM
composition.method: Pillow raster title typography over Aigram-generated raster art
